selection_rule: V1 canonical block and two preceding fixed offsets of 7200 blocks; USDC/WETH pools at fee tiers3000 and500, chosen before any V2 stress analysis.

pools.reason: Same pair, lower fee-tier contrast; not selected by stress outcome

borrower_rule: First three distinct raw addresses sorted lexicographically from V1 verified-borrower snapshot; availability sentinels only, not a representative V2 cohort or new population discovery.
acceptance: Chain ID1; finalized block identity equals registration
Factory, tokens, fee and decimals agree at the same historical block
Two independent fetch passes produce identical canonical deterministic content hash
Historical pool->addresses provider->oracle configuration and asset prices traced at pinned block
All missing fields quarantined as null/unavailable, never zero or forward-filled
missing_data_rule: Quarantine unavailable/mismatched data; retain successful independent components with component statuses; no latest/spot/forward-fill replacement.

tick_scope.selection: Eight initialized ticks nearest current tick within current bitmap word; deterministic tie by tick number

event_scope: Exact registered blocks only; no assertion of exhaustive historical borrower/event census.

header_discovery.source_scope: Header agreement, not independent consensus proof
